protocol AdService {
    var isMock: Bool { get }
    func canShow(_ placementId: String, _ nowSeconds: Int) -> Bool
    func show(_ placementId: String, _ nowSeconds: Int, onReward: (_ rewardKind: String, _ rewardAmount: Int) -> Void) -> Bool
}

enum FrequencyLimit {
    static func canShow(_ minSecondsBetween: Int, _ maxPerSession: Int, _ shownCount: Int, _ lastShownSeconds: Int, _ nowSeconds: Int) -> Bool {
        if shownCount >= maxPerSession { return false }
        if lastShownSeconds < 0 { return true }
        return nowSeconds - lastShownSeconds >= minSecondsBetween
    }
}
